output.title: Signature algorithm customization: scope and default behavior not stated
output.content: The release note (ev-87995aee2ded) only says the signature algorithm can now be customized (#7591). It does not say which resource or field controls this, or whether existing behavior changes when the setting is left unset. The environment uses cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate (CRD certificates.cert-manager.io [v1]), and none of the four values keys set relate to signing, so the change may touch these resources, but the excerpt doesn't show that it does. Check PR #7591 to see where the setting lives and whether it changes anything for existing Certificates that don't set it.
